import numpy as np, os,re
from collections import deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# restart comps fresh
def comps(b):
    b=np.array(b); seen=np.zeros_like(b,dtype=bool); out=[]
    for i in range(b.shape[0]):
        for j in range(b.shape[1]):
            if b[i,j]!=0 and not seen[i,j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    r,c=q.popleft(); cells.append((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                        if 0<=nr<b.shape[0] and 0<=nc<b.shape[1] and not seen[nr,nc] and b[nr,nc]==b[r,c]:
                            seen[nr,nc]=True;q.append((nr,nc))
                out.append(list(cells))
    return out

        hh=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; ww=max(cs)-min(cs)+1

import os,re,numpy as np
from collections import deque
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
def comps(b):
    b=np.array(b); seen=np.zeros_like(b,dtype=bool); out=[]
    for i in range(b.shape[0]):
        for j in range(b.shape[1]):
            if b[i,j]!=0 and not seen[i,j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    r,c=q.popleft(); cells.append((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                        if 0<=nr<b.shape[0] and 0<=nc<b.shape[1] and not seen[nr,nc] and b[nr,nc]==b[r,c]:
                            seen[nr,nc]=True;q.append((nr,nc))
                out.append(list(cells))
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    i=np.array(G[name+' input']); o=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    sep=np.argwhere(i==5)[0][0]
    print('===',name,'sep',sep)
    allc=comps(i); botc=comps(i[sep+1:])
    # build map: normalize each comp -> (mask tuple, color, orig_row)
    items=[]
    for s in allc:
        col=i[s[0][0]][s[0][1]]
        rs=[r for r,c in s]; cs=[c for r,c in s]
        R,C=min(rs),min(cs); hh=max(rs)-R+1; ww=max(cs)-C+1
        mk=tuple(tuple(1 if (r,c) in set(s) else 0 for c in range(C,C+ww)) for r in range(R,R+hh))
        items.append((mk,col,min(rs)))
    outs=[]
    for s in comps(o):
        col=o[s[0][0]][s[0][1]]
        rs=[r for r,c in s]; cs=[c for r,c in s]
        R,C=min(rs),min(cs); hh=max(rs)-R+1; ww=max(cs)-C+1
        mk=tuple(tuple(1 if (r,c) in {(a,b) for a,b,_ in s} else 0 for c in range(C,C+ww)) for r in range(R,R+hh))
        outs.append((mk,col,min(rs),max(rs)))
    print('  input comps:',items)
    print('  output objs:',outs)

                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; cells=[]
                while q:

import numpy as np, json
from collections import deque
def comps(b):
    seen=np.zeros_like(b,dtype=bool); out=[]
    for i in range(b.shape[0]):
        for j in range(b.shape[1]):
            if b[i,j]!=0 and not seen[i,j]:
                c=int(b[i,j]); q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    r,cc=q.popleft(); cells.append((r,cc))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,cc+dc
                        if 0<=nr<b.shape[0] and 0<=nc<b.shape[1] and not seen[nr,nc] and b[nr,nc]==c:
                            seen[nr,nc]=True; q.append((nr,nc))
                out.append((c,cells))
    return out
def f(inp):
    i=np.array(inp); H,W=i.shape
    sep=[r for r in range(H) if (i[r]==5).all()][0]
    kept=[]
    seenm={}
    for band,name in [('top',i[:sep]),('bot',i[sep+1:])]:
        for c,cells in comps(band):
            if c==2: continue
            rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[cc for _,cc in cells]
            m=tuple(sorted(cells))
            if m in seenm:
                if name=='top': continue      # keep bottom copy
                seenm[m]=name
            else: seenm[m]=name
            kept.append((c,cells,(name,)))
    # remove duplicates (keep bottom copy)
    def norm(cells):
        rs=min(r for r,_ in cells); cs=min(cc for _,cc in cells)
        return tuple(sorted((r-rs,cc-cs) for r,cc in cells)),(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
    uniq=[]
    seen=set()
    for c,cells,name in kept:
        n,mbox=norm(cells)
        if (c,n,mbox) in seen: continue
        seen.add((c,n,mbox))
        uniq.append((c,cells,mbox))
    uniq.sort(key=lambda t:(-len(t[1]),-t[0]))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(9)]
    tot=0
    for c,cells,(mbox,) in uniq:
        rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[cc for _,cc in cells]
        sh,sw=max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cs)-min(cs)+1
        # horizontal: center shape's bbox in cols 5..7 band => target cols 5..7
        shift=5-min(cs)
        for r,cc in cells:
            out[r-min(rs)+tot][cc+shift]=c
        tot+=sh
    return out
ok=True
for n in range(1,5):
    pi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; po=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    p=f(pi)
    m=(p==po)
    print(n, m)
    ok&=m
print('ALL:',ok)

def bnd(comps,rowsep):
    upper=[p for p in comps if max(q[0] for q in p[1])<rowsep]
    lower=[p for p in comps if min(q[0] for q in p[1])>rowsep]
    return upper,lower
for i,(inp,out) in enumerate(pairs):
    print('=== demo',i+1,'INPUT')
    cs=find_comps(inp)
    u,l=bnd(cs,5)
    print('upper:',[(col,min(q[0] for q in p),min(q[1] for q in p),max(q[0] for q in p)) for col,p in u])
    print('lower:',[(col,min(q[0] for q in p),min(q[1] for q in p),max(q[0] for q in p)) for col,p in l])
    print('OUTPUT')
    co=find_comps(out)
    for col,p in co:
        print(f'   {col} rows{min(q[0] for q in p)}..{max(q[0] for q in p)} cols{min(q[1] for q in p)}..{max(q[1] for q in p)}')

def comps(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);seen=set();out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            col=v;st=[(r,c)];cmp=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                if (a,b) in seen or g[a][b]!=col: continue
                seen.add((a,b));cmp.append((a,b))
                for da in(-1,0,1):
                    for db in(-1,0,1):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and (x,y) not in seen and g[x][y]==col: st.append((x,y))
            out.append((col,cmp))
    return out
def f(inp):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0])
    sep=next(i for i,row in enumerate(inp) if all(x==5 for x in row))
    cis=comps(inp)
    # pair: two comps same color, identical normalized shape
    pair=None
    for j in range(len(cis)):
        for k in range(j+1,len(cis)):
            col,s1=cis[j];col2,s2=cis[k]
            if col==5 or col2==5: continue
            n1=tuple(sorted((r-min(r for r,_ in s1), c-min(c for _,c in s1)) for r,c in s1))
            n2=tuple(sorted((r-min(r for r,_ in s2), c-min(c for _,c in s2)) for r,c in s2))
            if n1==n2: pair=((col,s1),(col,s2));break
    if pair is None: return [[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    pcolor=(pair[0][0]+pair[1][0])//2
    sa,pb=pair
    rs=[r for r,_ in pb];cs=[c for _,c in pb]
    A=pb
    rr=min(rs);cc=min(cs)
    hh=max(rs)-rr+1;ww=max(cs)-cc+1
    others=[(col,s) for col,s in cis if col!=5 and (col,s) not in [(pcolor,sa)] for pcolor,sa,_ in [(None,None)] ] 
    # simpler: collect comps that are neither sep nor pair comps
    pc_set={(a,sa),(b,sb)}
    others=[c for c in cis if c not in pc_set and c[0]!=5]
    kept=max(others,key=lambda x:len(x[1]))
    kc=max(c for _,c in kept[1])
    ac=max(c for _,c in A)
    above = kc!=ac  # kept original cols disjoint from A cols -> above; else below
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r,c in A:
        out[r-(rr+sep+1)][c]=pcolor
    for r,c in kept[1]:
        cr=r-cc   # relative to A left
        if above:
            rr_=min(rr for r_,_ in A)-1+(max(r for r,_ in kept[1])-min(r for r,_ in kept[1])+1)  # placeholder
        out[(r-rr-(0 if above else hh))+ (bb:= (max(r for r,_ in A)-rr))-hh+([None])[0]][c-cc]=kept[0]
    return out

def f2(inp):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0])
    sep=next(i for i,row in enumerate(inp) if all(x==5 for x in row))
    cis=comps(inp)
    pair=None
    for j in range(len(cis)):
        for k in range(j+1,len(cis)):
            col,s1=cis[j];col2,s2=cis[k]
            if col==5 or col2==5: continue
            def norm(s):
                mrs=min(r for r,_ in s);mcc=min(c for _,c in s)
                return tuple(sorted((r-mrs,c-mcc) for r,c in s))
            if norm(s1)==norm(s2): pair=((col,s1),(col,s2));break
    A=[x[1] for x in pair if min(r for r,_ in x[1])>=sep+1]
    A=A[0]

    kept=max(others,key=lambda x:len(x[1]))
    ka=max(c for _,c in kept[1]); aa=max(c for _,c in A)
    above = ka!=aa
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # draw A shifted up by sep+1
    for r,c in A:
        out[r-(min(r for r,_ in A)+sep+1)][c]=pair[0][0]
    kr=min(r for r,_ in kept[1])

import json
# Build prediction with rule: pair = bottom copy moved up 6; kept (farthest extra comp) flush ABOVE pair,
# centered on pair columns; verify geometry mentally matches demos 1-3 (kept always above pair there).
ti=G['Test input']
W=15
H=15
sep=next(i for i in range(H) if all(v==5 for v in ti[i]))
def comps(g):
    seen=[[False]*len(g[0]) for _ in g]; out=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r][c]!=0 and not seen[r][c]:
                st=[(r,c)];cls=[];seen[r][c]=True
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop();cls.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<len(g) and 0<=nx<len(g[0]) and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==g[r][c]:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True;st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append((g[r][c],sorted(cls)))
    return out
up=comps(ti[:sep]); bot=comps(ti[sep+1:])
pairc=[(v,a) for v,a in up if any(b==a[1] for _,b in bot) for v,a in [(v,a)]][:1]
# find pair: same color, identical cell set up to translation
best=None
for va in up:
    na=tuple(sorted((y-min(y2 for y2,_ in va[1]),x-min(x2 for _,x2 in va[1])) for y,x in va[1]))
    for vb in bot:
        nb=tuple(sorted((y-min(y2 for y2,_ in vb[1]),x-min(x2 for _,x2 in vb[1])) for y,x in vb[1]))
        if va[0]==vb[0] and na==nb:
            pa,pb=(va,vb)
pa,pb=pa,pb
others=[c for c in up+bot if c not in (pa,pb)]
kept=max(others,key=lambda c:(max(x for _,x in c[1])-min(x for _,x in c[1])))
pt=min(y for y,_ in pa[1])
pbm=max(y for y,_ in pb[1])
base=pt-1-(max(y for y,_ in kept[1])-min(y for y,_ in kept[1]))
sh=(min(x for _,x in pa[1])+max(x for _,x in pa[1]))//2-(min(x for _,x in kept[1])+max(x for _,x in kept[1]))//2
out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
for y,x in pb[1]: out[y-base+(min(y for y,_ in pb[1])) ][x+sh]=pb[0]
for y,x in kept[1]: out[base+(y-min(y for y,_ in kept[1]))][x+sh]=kept[0]
print(json.dumps(out))

import json
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sep=next(i for i in range(H) if all(v==5 for v in g[i]))
    def comps(gr):
        seen=[[False]*len(gr[0]) for _ in gr]; out=[]
        for r in range(len(gr)):
            for c in range(len(gr[0])):
                if gr[r][c] and not seen[r][c]:
                    st=[(r,c)];cl=[];seen[r][c]=True
                    while st:
                        y,x=st.pop();cl.append((y,x))
                        for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<len(gr) and 0<=nx<len(gr[0]) and not seen[ny][nx] and gr[ny][nx]==gr[r][c]:
                                seen[ny][nx]=True;st.append((ny,nx))
                    out.append((gr[r][c],sorted(cl)))
        return out
    t=comps(g[:sep]); b=comps(g[sep+1:])
    pair=None
    for va in t:
        ka=tuple(sorted((y-min(yy for yy,_ in va[1]),x-min(xx for _,xx in va[1])) for y,x in va[1]))
        for vb in b:
            kb=tuple(sorted((y-min(yy for yy,_ in vb[1]),x-min(xx for _,xx in vb[1])) for y,x in vb[1]))
            if va[0]==vb[0] and ka==kb: pair=(va,vb)
    pa,pb=pair
    others=[c for c in t+b if c not in (pa,pb)]
    kept=max(others,key=lambda c:(max(x for _,x in c[1])-min(x for _,x in c[1])))
    pcols=list({x for _,x in pa[1]}|{x for _,x in pb[1]})
    pc=(min(pcols)+max(pcols))/2
    kc=(min(x for _,x in kept[1])+max(x for _,x in kept[1]))/2
    sh=int(round(kc-pc))
    # vertical: keep original side relation; demo3/4 style: place kept flush adjacent below/above pair
    if max(y for y,_ in kept[1]) < min(y for y,_ in pa[1]): side='above'
    else: side='below'
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if side=='above':
        base=min(y for y,_ in pa[1])-1-(max(y for y,_ in kept[1])-min(y for y,_ in kept[1]))
        for y,x in kept[1]: out[base+(y-min(y for y,_ in kept[1]))][x+sh]=kept[0]
        for y,x in pb[1]: out[min(y for y,_ in pb[1])-1+(y-min(y for y,_ in pb[1]))][x+sh]=pb[0]
    else:
        base=max(y for y,_ in pb[1])+1
        for y,x in kept[1]: out[base+(y-min(y for y,_ in kept[1]))][x+sh]=kept[0]
        for y,x in pb[1]: out[base+(y-min(y for y,_ in pb[1]))][x+sh]=pb[0]
    return out
for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    print(n, solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

        for r in range(len(gr)):
            for c in range(len(gr[0])):

                    st=[(r,c)];cl=[];seen[r][c]=True
                    while st:

                        for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                    out.append((gr[r][c],sorted(cl)))

    def key(cs):
        rs=[y for y,_ in cs]; cls=[x for _,x in cs]

    pair=None

        h=pbt-pbs+1
        for y,x in kept[1]: out[base+(y-kr)][x+sh]=kept[0]

def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    sep=[i for i in range(H) if all(x==5 for x in g[i])][0]
    top=g[:sep]; bot=g[sep+1:]
    def comps(grid):
        R=[[False]*len(r) for r in grid]; out=[]
        for rr,row in enumerate(grid):
            for cc,v in enumerate(row):
                if not R[rr][cc] and v:
                    st=v; stack=[(rr,cc)]; cells=[]; R[rr][cc]=True
                    while stack:
                        r,c=stack.pop(); cells.append((r,c))
                        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            n=(r+dr,c+dc)
                            if 0<=n[0]<len(grid) and 0<=n[1]<len(grid[0]) and not R[n[0]][n[1]] and grid[n[0]][n[1]]==st:
                                R[n[0]][n[1]]=True; stack.append(n)
                    out.append((st,cells))
        return out
    ts=comps(top); bs=comps(bot)
    relmap={}
    res=[]  # (shape_rel, color, from_region)
    for s,cs in ts:
        rel=tuple(sorted((r-min(r for _,r in cs),c-min(c for _,c in cs)) for r,c in cs)); res.append(('t',s,rel,cs))
    for s,cs in bs:
        rel=tuple(sorted((r-min(r for _,r in cs),c-min(c for _,c in cs)) for r,c in cs)); res.append(('b',s,rel,cs))
    tset={(s,rel) for _,s,rel,_ in res if True and False}
    # pair: same rel, one t one b
    pairs=[]; seen=set()
    for item in res:
        if item[0]=='t': continue
        key=item[2]
        cand=[i for i in res if i[0]=='t' and i[2]==key]
        if cand:
            pairs.append((cand[0],item))
    # unique top shapes (not part of a pair)
    uniq=[i for i in res if i[0]=='t' and not any(p[0][0]=='t' and p[0][2]==i[2] for p in pairs)]
    # build output placements
    out=[]
    for duptop,dupbot in pairs:
        rel=duptop[2]; c=duptop[1]
        rs=[r for r,c2 in dupbot[3]]; cs=[c2 for r,c2 in dupbot[3]]
        top_r,minr=min(rs); minc=min(cs)
        col_center=minc+(max(cs)-min(cs))//2
        # duplicate -> moved up so top becomes sep+1... observed: output rows = input rows -6 => top_r-6 .. 
        # check: dup out top = sep? d1: sep5, dup in rows11-13 -> out 5-7 => top = sep. So out rows = [top_r-6, top_r-4]
        ro=[r-(top_r-minr)*1 for r in rs]; # redo: shift = top_r - 6
        shift=top_r-6
        crs=[r+shift for r in rs]; ccols=[c for r,c in dupbot[3]]
        # window col: [col_center-1, col_center+1]
        out.append((c,crs,col_center))
    for s,rel,cc,cs in uniq:
        rs=[r for r,c2 in cs]; top_r=min(rs)
        # unique placed above duplicate, touching: top = min(dup_crs)-3 if dup exists else 0
        dtops=[p[1] for p in pairs]
        ref=min(r for crs,cc_ in [p[1] for p in pairs] for r in crs) if dtops else 0
        shift=ref-3
        crs=[r+shift for r in rs]
        col_center=cc+(max(c2 for r,c2 in cs)-min(c2 for r,c2 in cs))//2
        out.append((s,crs,col_center))
    # ordering: descending color, but if unique.color < dup.color put dup first (d3 anomaly handled below)
    info=[]
    for c,crs,cc in out:
        info.append((c,-c if False else c,crs,cc,'DUP' if c in [p[0] for p in pairs] else 'UNIQ'))
    # reorder: DUPs first if their color < unique color, else uniques first
    dps=[i for i in info if i[4]=='DUP']; us=[i for i in info if i[4]=='UNIQ']
    order=[dp for dp in dps]+us if (dps and us and dps[0][0]<min(u[0] for u in us)) else [u for u in us]+dps
    return None

def build(pairlist, uniqlist, order_mode):

    res=[]
    for dt,db in pairlist:
